verdict.rationale: Orrick documents a dedicated Cyber, Privacy & Data Innovation Group that helps companies address global compliance requirements and reduce cyber risk. It also offers a Privacy-in-a-Box solution for complying with the fast-evolving data legal landscape. However, no named privacy regime is evidenced, so coverage of the story's specific laws is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit mention of GDPR, CCPA, India's DPDP Act or named local equivalents; detail on scope of privacy counseling services; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the firm counsels on privacy and data-protection compliance (GDPR, CCPA, India's DPDP Act, or local equivalents) through a documented privacy/cyber practice

citations.quote: Orrick's Cyber, Privacy & Data Innovation Group partners with technology-driven companies to maximize data value, address global compliance requirements and reduce cyber risk
comply with the fast-evolving legal landscape
